object.value: Surfaces, class policies and property roles that connect SHACL shapes to Maestro's record viewer and result set items.
A place in Maestro's UI where one RDF resource is presented.
The full description of one record: every property and role, grouped and ordered by the shape. Shown when a record is opened.
The compact card for one record in the result set. It is composed from property roles, not from every property.

Declares how instances of one or more classes are presented. A policy points at one SHACL node shape per surface. Only the record shape carries sh:targetClass, so a renderer that looks shapes up by target always finds the canonical shape; item shapes are reached through the policy.
A class whose instances this policy presents. A policy may cover several equivalent classes.
The SHACL node shape a renderer applies to a focus node on some surface.
Annotates a mui:surfaceShape sub-property with the surface it serves.
The shape for the record viewer. Lists every property shape, with groups and sh:order. Exactly one per policy.

The shape for result set items. By convention it lists exactly the property shapes of the record shape that carry a property role, except mui:IdentifierRole and mui:CodeRole, which are technical and record-viewer only. Exactly one per policy.
True when users must not edit the values: they are system-managed or come from a source Maestro does not write to. On a node shape it applies to every property shape unless overridden.
The language of a code value, such as xml, sparql, json or turtle. Used with mui:CodeRole so a viewer can pick highlighting.
Values worth showing in a summary even though they are not a label, description or date: publisher, licence, size.
The date or date-time that best says when a resource was created, published or last changed. Used for display and for ordering.
Values that lead somewhere: an outbound URL, an endpoint, a link that restores saved UI state.
Machine-readable identifiers such as hashes and codes. Technical: shown in the record viewer, never in result items.
Values that are source text (XML, SPARQL, JSON) and should be shown verbatim in a code view. Pair with mui:syntax. Technical: record viewer only.
An XSLT 1.0 stylesheet that formats FCT DESCRIBE XML while preserving Maestro rendering and actions. The stylesheet is stored as an RDF literal.
On a policy shape, the requested widget class; on a Provider, a concrete implementation resource.
Optional XSLT query-pivot implementation used to retrieve linked RDF data for a Record formatter.
The XSLT stylesheet source. Store the stylesheet as a literal; RDF/XML CDATA is only a serialization detail.
In a Maestro XSLT result template, the value is the full property URI whose value(s) in the current query scope populate the element.
In a Maestro XSLT result template, the value is the id of an embedded XML query whose results instantiate the component.

Declares a constrained interaction routed through Maestro's approved live-query update API. The initial interpreter accepts only a direct allowlisted fctQueryTreeApi method call with literal or approved data-binding arguments; template content is never evaluated as unrestricted JavaScript or TypeScript.
An XSLT-result instruction for a bounded sandbox query operation or a queued live query edit. Calls are validated by Maestro and never run as JavaScript.
The SPARQL translation of the saved vfct:historyQueryXML query, stored as text for inspection and reuse.
